Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing penalties for trading in nonambulatory livestock.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to penalties for trading in nonambulatorylivestock; adding a new section to chapter 16.36 RCW; prescribingpenalties; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 16.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person who knowingly transports or accepts delivery ofnonambulatory livestock is subject to a fine of up to one thousanddollars per day. The transport or acceptance of each nonambulatorylivestock animal is considered a separate and distinct violation. Thefine authorized in this section is in addition to any criminalviolation specified in RCW 16.36.110 and any other penalty provided bylaw. (2) The department shall set the amount of the fine authorized inthis section after considering the: (a) History of the violator; (b) Severity of the violation's impact on the health and safety ofthe public and the state's animal population; and p. 1 HB 2802 (c) Significance of the risk created for the health and safety ofthe public and the state's animal population. (3) This section does not apply to the: (a) Transport or acceptance by a veterinarian licensed underchapter 18.92 RCW of nonambulatory livestock under his or her care,including the delivery or acceptance by a veterinarian licensed underchapter 18.92 RCW of nonambulatory livestock to provide appropriatemedical care and treatment or euthanasia of a nonambulatory livestockanimal; and (b) Transport of nonambulatory livestock for the appropriate care,medical treatment, or euthanasia on a farm.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
